Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 10751 of 2022
Applicant :- Kshama Gupta

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravi Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
01.
Heard Sri Ravi Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri O.P. Mishra, learned AGA for the State and perused the papers on record.
02. The present application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime no. 329 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C., P.S. Barkhera, District Pilibhit.

03. As per prosecution case, District Inspector of Schools, Pilibhit conducted an enquiry as regard B.ed. certificate and the marksheet and it was intimated that there was no record of the applicant Kshama Gupta (Assistant Teacher, Pandit Devdatt Sharma, J.E. College, Barkhera, Pilibhit) at all.
Therefore, the manager/principal was directed to get an F.I.R. registered.

On the basis of this F.I.R.,
above case crime was registered and is being investigated upon.

04. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that she is absolutely innocent and that only material against her is that no paper was in existence to verify her degree and marksheet in the concerned office.

05. The anticipatory bail application is opposed by the learned A.G.A. Following facts and Kshama Gupta vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150700712/

sentences.text:
arguments have been placed before me:-
i.

The matter was enquired into by the concerned officer and on the basis of statements/reports given by Assistant Registrar of Mahatama Gandhi Kashi Vidyapeeth that the papers in question were fabricated.

The F.I.R. came to be registered.
ii.
It is argued that there was no question of false allegations.
Sufficient material has been collected to show that fake markesheet and certificate were prepared to obtain job.
06. Prima facie it does not appear that the F.I.R. has been lodged against the applicant for the purpose of bringing disgrace or cause humiliation to her by having her arrested in a mala fide manner.
It may also be kept in mind that anticipatory bail is an extraordinary remedy to be exercised in suitable cases only.
The powers under Section 438 Cr.P.C. cannot be utilized in a routine manner and definitely not as a substitute for regular bail.

This discretionary power calls for existence of facts of the kind where the court is satisfied that its interference is necessary to further the cause of justice and to prevent misuse of process of law.
07. In view of the facts and circumstances of the case I do not find it fit case to grant benefit of anticipatory bail.
08. Hence the anticipatory bail application is rejected.

09. It is made clear that observations made in rejecting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.

Order Date :- 20.1.2023 Asha  Kshama Gupta vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150700712/
